title: Ask HN: What would happen if your company stopped using all AI tomorrow?
excerpt: This is something I’ve been turning over in my head lately. I’m not denying AI is being used everywhere, but I don’t know if it’s actually helping businesses overall. If we shut it all down it seems that businesses would be fine (and maybe even better since there’d be no token burning budgets).
content_html:
Ask HN: What would happen if your company stopped using all AI tomorrow?
34 points by jc_811 1 day ago | hide | past | favorite | 68 comments

This is something I’ve been turning over in my head lately. I’m not denying AI is being used everywhere, but I don’t know if it’s actually helping businesses overall. If we shut it all down it seems that businesses would be fine (and maybe even better since there’d be no token burning budgets).
